label: Paper Ground (print-world surface)
description: The paper world's full-bleed painted sheet: warm cream tone, pulp mottle, hairline fibers, speckle, edge-fold shading and a soft warm vignette -- deterministic from the world seed so every scene sits on the same piece of paper. Sets the ink channel (--mp-ink, --mp-paper) consumed by pen-script, typewriter print/cli, para-edit and ink-aware templates. The intensity dial spans clean print (0.15) to letterpress (0.85).

tone.label: Paper tone hex (default #f2efe7; never pure white)

texture_url.label: PHOTOGRAPHIC TOOTH: a neutral macro surface tile (/assets/... PNG from generate_clip mode='texture'). Stamped at random rotation with feathered edges -- real paper relief instead of procedural noise. Omit for the procedural sheet.
